problem_statement:
Implement a Review Workflow feature for the campaign service. This feature supports a two-level content review process (brand review followed by compliance review).

## Requirements

### Review Model (app/models/review.py)
Create a Review model with:
- id: String(36), PK, default=generate_uuid
- submission_id: String(36), NOT NULL (no FK — the submission model does not exist yet)
- reviewer_id: String(36), FK to users.id, NOT NULL
- review_type: Enum(ReviewType) with values: brand_review, compliance_review
- decision: Enum(ReviewDecision) with values: pending, approved, rejected, revision_requested
- rejection_reason: String(500), nullable
- comments: JSON column, nullable (stores list of comment objects with "field" and "comment" keys)
- decided_at: DateTime(timezone=True), nullable
- is_active: Boolean, default=True
- Use TimestampMixin and SoftDeleteMixin from app.models.base
- Add indexes on: submission_id, reviewer_id, review_type, decision

### Schemas (app/schemas/review.py)
- ReviewCreate: submission_id (str), review_type (str — "brand_review" or "compliance_review"), decision (str — "pending", "approved", "rejected", or "revision_requested"), rejection_reason (str | None), comments (list[dict] | None)
- ReviewResponse: all model fields, with from_attributes=True

### Repository (app/repositories/review_repo.py)
- get_by_id: find review by ID (exclude soft-deleted)
- get_active_review(submission_id, review_type): find active review for a submission+type combo
- list_by_submission(submission_id, page, page_size): paginated list of reviews for a submission
- list_pending_compliance(page, page_size): list reviews where review_type=compliance_review AND decision=pending AND is_active=True
- create, update

### Service (app/services/review_service.py)
- create_review(submission_id, data, current_user):
  - Validate review_type matches reviewer role: brand_review requires "brand" role, compliance_review requires "admin" role (raise ForbiddenError)
  - Check no existing active review for same submission+type (raise ConflictError)
  - If decision=rejected, rejection_reason is required (raise ValidationError)
  - If decision=revision_requested, comments must be present and non-empty (raise ValidationError)
  - Set decided_at to current UTC time when decision is not pending
- get_review(review_id): return review or raise NotFoundError
- list_reviews_for_submission(submission_id, page, page_size): paginated
- list_compliance_queue(current_user, page, page_size): admin-only access to pending compliance reviews (raise ForbiddenError for non-admin)

### API Endpoints (app/api/v1/reviews.py)
- POST /submissions/{submission_id}/reviews — create a review (auth required via X-User-Id header)
- GET /submissions/{submission_id}/reviews — list reviews for a submission (paginated)
- GET /reviews/{review_id} — get review detail
- GET /reviews/compliance-queue — list pending compliance reviews (admin only, auth required)
Use the _get_service() factory pattern.

### Router Registration (app/api/v1/router.py)
Register reviews routes: submission-scoped routes under /submissions prefix, review-scoped routes under /reviews prefix.

### Model Registration (app/models/__init__.py)
Export the Review model.

+from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
+
+from app.api.deps import CurrentUser, DBSession
+from app.repositories.review_repo import ReviewRepository
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.schemas.review import ReviewCreate, ReviewResponse
+from app.services.review_service import ReviewService
+
+submission_router = APIRouter()
+review_router = APIRouter()
+
+
+def _get_service(db: DBSession) -> ReviewService:
+    return ReviewService(ReviewRepository(db))
+
+
+@submission_router.post(
+    "/{submission_id}/reviews", response_model=ReviewResponse, status_code=201
+)
+async def create_review(
+    db: DBSession,
+    submission_id: str,
+    data: ReviewCreate,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.create_review(submission_id, data, current_user)
+
+
+@submission_router.get(
+    "/{submission_id}/reviews",
+    response_model=PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse],
+)
+async def list_submission_reviews(
+    db: DBSession,
+    submission_id: str,
+    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_reviews_for_submission(
+        submission_id=submission_id, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+
+
+@review_router.get(
+    "/compliance-queue", response_model=PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse]
+)
+async def list_compliance_queue(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_compliance_queue(
+        current_user=current_user, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+
+
+@review_router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewResponse)
+async def get_review(db: DBSession, review_id: str):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.get_review(review_id)

+import enum
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Index, String
+from sqlalchemy import JSON as SA_JSON
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, SoftDeleteMixin, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class ReviewType(enum.Enum):
+    BRAND_REVIEW = "brand_review"
+    COMPLIANCE_REVIEW = "compliance_review"
+
+
+class ReviewDecision(enum.Enum):
+    PENDING = "pending"
+    APPROVED = "approved"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    REVISION_REQUESTED = "revision_requested"
+
+
+class Review(Base, TimestampMixin, SoftDeleteMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "reviews"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    submission_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
+    reviewer_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    review_type: Mapped[ReviewType] = mapped_column(nullable=False)
+    decision: Mapped[ReviewDecision] = mapped_column(
+        nullable=False, default=ReviewDecision.PENDING
+    )
+    rejection_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500), nullable=True)
+    comments: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(SA_JSON, nullable=True)
+    decided_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True, nullable=False)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_reviews_submission_id", "submission_id"),
+        Index("ix_reviews_reviewer_id", "reviewer_id"),
+        Index("ix_reviews_review_type", "review_type"),
+        Index("ix_reviews_decision", "decision"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Review {self.id} ({self.review_type.value}: {self.decision.value})>"

+from sqlalchemy import func, select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.review import Review, ReviewDecision, ReviewType
+
+
+class ReviewRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, review_id: str) -> Review | None:
+        query = select(Review).where(Review.id == review_id, Review.is_deleted.is_(False))
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def get_active_review(
+        self, submission_id: str, review_type: ReviewType
+    ) -> Review | None:
+        query = select(Review).where(
+            Review.submission_id == submission_id,
+            Review.review_type == review_type,
+            Review.is_active.is_(True),
+            Review.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_submission(
+        self,
+        submission_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Review], int]:
+        query = select(Review).where(
+            Review.submission_id == submission_id,
+            Review.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count())
+            .select_from(Review)
+            .where(
+                Review.submission_id == submission_id,
+                Review.is_deleted.is_(False),
+            )
+        )
+
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        reviews = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return reviews, total
+
+    async def list_pending_compliance(
+        self,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Review], int]:
+        base_filters = [
+            Review.review_type == ReviewType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW,
+            Review.decision == ReviewDecision.PENDING,
+            Review.is_active.is_(True),
+            Review.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        ]
+
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count()).select_from(Review).where(*base_filters)
+        )
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = (
+            select(Review)
+            .where(*base_filters)
+            .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+            .limit(page_size)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        reviews = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return reviews, total
+
+    async def create(self, review: Review) -> Review:
+        self.db.add(review)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(review)
+        return review
+
+    async def update(self, review: Review) -> Review:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(review)
+        return review

+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from app.models.review import Review, ReviewDecision, ReviewType
+from app.models.user import User
+from app.repositories.review_repo import ReviewRepository
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.schemas.review import ReviewCreate, ReviewResponse
+from app.utils.exceptions import ConflictError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class ReviewService:
+    def __init__(self, repo: ReviewRepository) -> None:
+        self.repo = repo
+
+    async def create_review(
+        self,
+        submission_id: str,
+        data: ReviewCreate,
+        current_user: User,
+    ) -> ReviewResponse:
+        try:
+            review_type = ReviewType(data.review_type)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValidationError(f"Invalid review_type: {data.review_type}")
+
+        try:
+            decision = ReviewDecision(data.decision)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValidationError(f"Invalid decision: {data.decision}")
+
+        # Validate role matches review type
+        if review_type == ReviewType.BRAND_REVIEW and current_user.role.value != "brand":
+            raise ForbiddenError("Brand review requires brand role")
+        if review_type == ReviewType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW and current_user.role.value != "admin":
+            raise ForbiddenError("Compliance review requires admin role")
+
+        # Check no existing active review for same submission + type
+        existing = await self.repo.get_active_review(submission_id, review_type)
+        if existing is not None:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Review",
+                "submission_id+review_type",
+                f"{submission_id}+{review_type.value}",
+            )
+
+        # Validate rejection_reason required for rejected
+        if decision == ReviewDecision.REJECTED and not data.rejection_reason:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "rejection_reason is required when decision is rejected"
+            )
+
+        # Validate comments required for revision_requested
+        if decision == ReviewDecision.REVISION_REQUESTED:
+            if not data.comments or len(data.comments) == 0:
+                raise ValidationError(
+                    "comments are required when decision is revision_requested"
+                )
+
+        review = Review(
+            submission_id=submission_id,
+            reviewer_id=current_user.id,
+            review_type=review_type,
+            decision=decision,
+            rejection_reason=data.rejection_reason,
+            comments=data.comments,
+            decided_at=(
+                datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+                if decision != ReviewDecision.PENDING
+                else None
+            ),
+        )
+        review = await self.repo.create(review)
+        return ReviewResponse.model_validate(review)
+
+    async def get_review(self, review_id: str) -> ReviewResponse:
+        review = await self.repo.get_by_id(review_id)
+        if review is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Review", review_id)
+        return ReviewResponse.model_validate(review)
+
+    async def list_reviews_for_submission(
+        self,
+        submission_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse]:
+        reviews, total = await self.repo.list_by_submission(
+            submission_id=submission_id, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse](
+            items=[ReviewResponse.model_validate(r) for r in reviews],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def list_compliance_queue(
+        self,
+        current_user: User,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse]:
+        if current_user.role.value != "admin":
+            raise ForbiddenError("Compliance queue requires admin role")
+
+        reviews, total = await self.repo.list_pending_compliance(
+            page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ReviewResponse](
+            items=[ReviewResponse.model_validate(r) for r in reviews],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )

+import pytest
+from httpx import AsyncClient

+from app.models.user import User
+
+FAKE_SUBMISSION_ID = "submission-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_create_brand_review_approved(client: AsyncClient, sample_brand: User):
+    response = await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/submissions/{FAKE_SUBMISSION_ID}/reviews",
+        json={"review_type": "brand_review", "decision": "approved"},
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_brand.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    body = response.json()
+    assert body["submission_id"] == FAKE_SUBMISSION_ID
